name: Paid Trial launch post
useWhen: You want to fill a low-ticket trial of your main program fast. Works for a $27 to $97 trial.
whyItWorks: Scarcity in the first line, three named client results as proof, the deliverables as a stack, one micro-commitment CTA ("me").
body:
🔥 For just [N] people, I'm considering launching a brand new $[PRICE] PAID TRIAL into my $[FULL PRICE] [PROGRAM NAME]…

Do you want in?

Over the past few years, I've helped [hundreds] of [who] go from [stuck state]… to [result state].

I built [PROGRAM NAME] from the trenches. No fluff. No BS. Just what works.

✅ The exact system that took [Client 1] from [before] to [after] in [time]
✅ The same process [Client 2] used to go from [before]… to [after] in [time]
✅ The step-by-step blueprint [Client 3] followed to [result] after [years of struggle]
✅ Weekly LIVE [call name] with me
✅ Access to my private [community name]
✅ [Bonus vault or resource]

🚀 Here's what real people are doing inside the same system you'll get access to:
✅ [Client 1] — [result]
✅ [Client 2] — [result]
✅ [Client 3] — [result]

This is the system that took me from [your before]… to [your after].

And for the first time ever, I'm considering giving FULL ACCESS to everything…

For just $[PRICE].

If I gave you access… would you want to take a look?

👇 Drop a "me" below if you're in.

First-come, first-serve.
